pages.alt: George returns to the cave the next morning

lines.text: The next morning, George ran back up the green hill to Pip's cave.
Pip! I'm here! How is the red egg today?
Come quickly, George! Something wonderful is happening!

pages.alt: The red egg begins to crack

lines.text: Inside the cave, the red egg shook gently on the soft moss.
Then a tiny crack appeared across the shiny shell.
Look! The egg is cracking. Stay close, Pip!
Crack! The shell opened, and a tiny red dragon peeked out.
Peep? Where am I?
This is my little sister! Her name is Ember.
Hello, Ember. Welcome to the world!
Ember shivered and rubbed her tiny red wings together.
I feel cold. And I think I am hungry too.
Don't worry. We can help you feel warm and full.

pages.alt: George and Pip gather moss and berries

lines.text: George gathered soft moss, and Pip found bright red berries nearby.
Here, Ember. These berries are sweet and safe.
And this moss will keep you warm like a blanket.
Thank you! You are both so kind.
After her snack, Ember stretched her little wings carefully.
Can I fly like you one day, Pip?
Yes! But first we practice slowly. Be careful.
I will watch you. You can do it, Ember!

pages.alt: Ember flies a little for the first time

lines.text: Ember flapped once, then twice, and rose a little into the air.
I'm flying! Just a little, but I'm flying!
Wow! That was amazing, Ember!
Well done, little sister. You were very brave.

pages.alt: George, Pip and Ember celebrate together

lines.text: Outside the cave, the three friends laughed in the warm sunlight.
Will you visit us again tomorrow, George?
Of course! We are a team now.
And George knew that the best adventures are the ones you share.

quiz.q: What happens to the red egg?
How do George and Pip help Ember?
options: They give her moss and berries
